integrity: Analytical theorem accompanied by independently implemented finite exact-rational checks. Infinite asymptotics follow from the written proof, not enumeration. Historical priority and independent mathematical audit have not been established.
scientific_limitations: Exact two layers, regular deterministic kernels, r>=3 and d>=3r-2. Sharp minimization requires integer lambda=r(r-1)/(d-1), and its attainment requires a corresponding symmetric design. The asymptotic minimum is attained along prime-power projective planes only. No general higher-layer or noninteger-lambda optimizer is claimed.
title: Design-rigid vacancy fluctuations after two permuted regular layers
